title: Siman 613
section: The Closeness of Rabbi Yudil to Rabbainu, of Blessed Memory
sectionHe: הִתְקָרְבוּת הָרַב יוּדִיל אֵצֶל רַבֵּנוּ זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה

segments.he: שָׁמַעְתִּיבִּשְׁמוֹ מֵהָרַב דְּפה בְּרֶסְלַב, שֶׁפַּעַם אַחַת הָיָה בַּדֶּרֶךְ וְהִתְפַּלֵל שַׁחֲרִית וְנָפַל עַל פָּנָיו עַל יְמִינוֹ
segments.en: (5.) "This is the aspect of prayer — as it is written [Deuteronomy 26]: 'You have declared G-d today.' Priests are the aspect of Torah in the aspect of souls — as it is written [Malachi 2]: 'For the lips of the priest should preserve knowledge and Torah should be sought from his mouth.' Aaron is the aspect of judgment — as it is written [Exodus 28]: 'And Aaron shall carry the judgment of the children of Israel.' For this requires the aspect of judgment. 'And you shall speak to them' — specifically v'amarta — for one must bring all the prayers to the aspect of Moses-Messiah..."
